title: "Demo manuscript for Starbuck"
bibliography: demo.bib
---

Spirometry must follow standard procedures [@miller2005; @graham2019]. Reference
values come from the Global Lung Function Initiative equations [@quanjer2012], which a
second reference also supports [@gli2012wrong]. They were later validated in 40,000
astronauts [@invented2024].

Older claims linking vaccines to developmental disorders [@wakefield1998] were refuted
[@deer2011]. The same standards paper is sometimes cited without a DOI [@millernodoi].
Transformer models [@vaswani2017] are now applied to lung function.
